picks.title: Philips Hue Bridge Pro custom AI behaviors launch next week
picks.rationale: New feature launch: Hue Bridge Pro users describe a lighting routine in plain language and AI builds the automation. Here the smart-home interface is a prompt, not a settings screen.
picks.excerpt: Philips Hue will soon roll out Custom AI Behaviors for the Hue Bridge Pro, letting users describe what they want in plain language to create a personalized lighting automation.

picks.title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover
picks.rationale: New announcement: GM rebuilds its 30-year-old OnStar service around an AI assistant, one of the biggest overhauls of the in-car connected product.
picks.excerpt: It's one of the biggest overhauls ever to the 30-year-old connected car product.

picks.title: Unitree reveals H2-X humanoid bodyguard robot — 'Kung Fu Legend Guardian' packs 8-hour battery and martial arts defense skills
picks.rationale: New product reveal: Unitree's H2-X is a humanoid 'guardian' robot with learned martial-arts defense moves and an 8-hour battery. It is an embodied-AI hardware launch from the best-known Chinese humanoid maker.
picks.excerpt: Unitree Robotics has revealed its impressive new H2-X Kung Fu Legend Guardian robot — a humanoid bodyguard from our sci-fi dreams.

picks.title: The Timekettle LiveTalk earbuds can play audio, translate, and help you learn a language
picks.rationale: New device hands-on: Timekettle's LiveTalk earbuds work as everyday earbuds and also do AI translation of conversations and audio in 54 languages. AI translation is the product.
picks.excerpt: Hands-on with Timekettle LiveTalk, AI translation earbuds that double as regular earbuds and translate conversations and audio across 54 languages.

picks.title: SpeakON introduces magnetic iPhone button with AI-powered voice actions
picks.rationale: New accessory launch: a magnetic iPhone button that sends speech to an AI agent, which drafts notes, reminders and emails for the user to approve. The AI agent is what makes it useful.
picks.excerpt: One button. No more endless tapping on your iPhone screen. SpeakON's magnetic accessory now comes with an AI agent that can turn your spoken thoughts into notes, reminders and emails, although you'll still have to approve the results.
